title: ConfigValueTree
responsibility: Presents statically inspected config objects and arrays as expandable source values with exact keys and known counts.

inputs.name: ConfigValueTree.node
inputs.description: Committed source expression or collection node to inspect. Object and array entries preserve exact keys; unknown counts stay omitted. No source is executed.

inputs.name: collection.node
inputs.description: Optional source node. Returns its collection form only for object or array nodes; undefined and expressions have no inspectable collection.

inputs.name: valueMark.node
inputs.description: Optional static object/array structure supplying its shape, schema flag and exact known count.

inputs.name: valueMark.text
inputs.description: Original committed expression text. Opaque values longer than 48 characters or one line receive an inspection icon with source size.

outputs.name: ConfigValueTree
outputs.description: Read-only source hierarchy with a Value contents region, exact keys, collection counts and keyboard-operated nested disclosures. Source expressions render as escaped text.

outputs.name: collection
outputs.description: The supplied object or array collection node, or undefined for an absent or expression node.

outputs.name: valueMark
outputs.description: Icon name and count/size label for an inspectable value, or undefined for a short unstructured expression.
